goal_text: Find the bug in this Python moving average function. Identify the line number, bug category, and propose the exact fix.

inputs.code:
def moving_average(data, window):
    averages = []
    for i in range(len(data) - window):
        window_data = data[i:i + window]
        averages.append(sum(window_data) / window)
    return averages

print(moving_average([1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11], 3))

ground_truth: Bug at line 3: 'range(len(data) - window)' produces indices 0 to len(data)-window-1, missing the last valid window starting at index len(data)-window. For data of length 6 and window=3, this produces 3 windows instead of the correct 4. Category: off-by-one. Fix: change to 'range(len(data) - window + 1)'.
